item.title: CVE-2026-11800: Keycloak has authentication bypass via jwt algorithm confusion
item.description: Severity: high. ### Description A flaw was found in Keycloak. This JWT algorithm confusion vulnerability in the JWT Authorization Grant flow allows an attacker with valid client credentials to bypass signature verification. By forging an assertion, the attacker can create unauthorized access tokens.
